annotations.title: Change what the AI assistant knows

description: Changes one AI assistant’s knowledge, named by id. action add takes a kind: file (media_id of a file uploaded on the assistant’s number), text (text, with an optional title), url (a website) or place (a Google Maps link); it answers at once with the source, and the assistant reads it in the background (a website is read again every month). action remove (sourceId) forgets a source and everything read from it, and only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview and a token for a person to approve. action refresh (sourceId) reads a source again now. action review_suggestion (suggestionId, accepted true or false, optional question and answer edits) turns a suggested answer into knowledge or drops it. Owners and admins.

action.description: add gives the assistant something to read. remove forgets one source. refresh reads one source again. review_suggestion accepts (with edits) or rejects a suggested answer.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

media_id.description: A file uploaded on this automation’s number with POST /v1/media. A file uploaded on another number is refused with media_other_number.

sourceId.description: The sourceId in the resource path.

suggestionId.description: The suggestionId in the resource path.
